<a id="missile_draw"></a>
### [`missile_draw`](../../../../src/missile/missile_update_58a0.asm#L6) `$58A0`

*routine*

Writes each active missile on the screen: character $13 for direction +1 (left), $12 for $ff (right). The colour comes from the table at $4000.
